text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Out of the fourth corner and onto the homestretch!
This is where the race is decided!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It is time for the trial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Kris S!!
It's Symboli Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
He will surrender the Autumn Emperor's Shield to no one!
The defending champion, Symboli Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A magnificent title defense!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooooa!! A historic moment!!
The first-ever back-to-back Tenno Sho (Autumn) victory! Seriously way too strong!!
Is there any Umamusume in Japan who can beat her?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "This is insane...! Seeing this, I'm actually getting excited to see just how strong she'll get!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Mission accomplished.
...I request your evaluation.
choice_data_list: That was your best win yet!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, next is――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A 2,400-meter showdown bringing together top Umamusume from both home and abroad. In that race—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Tap is coming.
—At her absolute best—stronger than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will meet them head-on.
And then—I will win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With unwavering resolve in her heart,
she began taking her first steps toward the next showdown...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as time steadily marched on—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...!!
Urgh...—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... I need more...!
While Kris S-san and the others... are running in the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I have to push past my limits... and get stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To stand alongside her—and surpass her...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. I can do this...!
I'm finally starting to make it through the whole run...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"With this... I can show them all
my ultimate, unmatched solo runaway—
where no one will ever catch me...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, Kris S...!!
I'll make the Japan Cup
the stage that makes my name known...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of their "passions" and feelings
were preparing to confront their "trials."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup was now
just around the corner—
